attack.note: Might of the Nerazim, Master Warp-Blade, Mending Strikes and Psionic Strength all reward weaving autos between abilities. Singularity Spike is his only ranged ability and is usually cast from melee.

poke.note: Singularity Spike can be fired from range but the guide says to avoid using it as poke because it is easy to heal off and a long cooldown.

damage.note: Cleave, Singularity Spike with a slow and weaved autos burst a squishy target in a couple of seconds, and Twilight Falls doubles the rotation. Mending Strikes lets him out sustain weak healers in 1v1. Burst gets through healing, but a fully healed and shielded target (Medivh, Uther, Divine Shield) survives.

good_into.why: Permanent Cloak, Blink and Vorpal Blade reach the backline unseen and Cleave plus Singularity Spike plus Might of the Nerazim kill it fast.
Stealth flanks bypass the front line, and Void Prison can split the enemy team in half so allies fight only the backline.
Mending Strikes and Shadow Mending beat weak healers in a duel and burst kills before an Uther or Morales heal lands.
Move Unseen gives fast stealth rotations and ganks on lone heroes, and Void Prison can freeze a camp or a structure.

bad_into.why: Targeted CC (Polymorph, Twilight Dream, Warlord's Challenge) hits him in the Wormhole window or after he commits, and he has low health.
Revealing abilities such as Eye of Kilrogg or area damage strip his main strength and leave a fragile hero exposed.
He is easy to kill once revealed and relies on cooldown timing for Blink, so he cannot trade with a dive comp.
Heroes who can react to Blink with their own gap closer leave him with no reliable follow up if Vorpal Blade fails.

wants_from_team: Combo partners for Void Prison (Diablo, Jaina)
Early game strength since he is weak early
gives_team: Void Prison setup for team combos or a split
weaknesses: Vulnerable to targeted crowd control and reveals
Low base health for a melee assassin
Weak early game, depends on Level 16 talents
evidence: Permanent Cloak, Blink, Vorpal Blade, Singularity Spike, Cleave
Might of the Nerazim and Void Prison heroics
Wormhole, Seeker in the Dark, Mending Strikes, Master Warp-Blade, Twilight Falls talents
Icy Veins guide: vulnerable to targeted CC, weak early, great ganker
Measured: about 2063 hero damage, 4886 siege, 2034 damage taken per minute, 0.4 CC seconds, win rate 0.526 over 350 games

lens_notes.damage_delivery: The catalog lists Zeratul as the melee brawler example. Cleave, weaved autos and Might Of The Nerazim all happen in melee, with Singularity Spike usually cast from melee range.
lens_notes.damage_reach: Singularity Spike is ranged but Icy Veins says to cast it from melee and not to poke with it.
lens_notes.damage_reliability: Singularity Spike is a skillshot, and Blink and Vorpal Blade need the target not to be hard CC'd or to have an auto landed first.
lens_notes.durability_source: Permanent Cloak, Blink (disjoints projectiles), Mending Strikes and Shroud of Adun. Icy Veins: low base health for a melee assassin.
lens_notes.escape: Blink, Vorpal Blade, Wormhole and Might Of The Nerazim give multiple outs. Targeted CC (polymorph, Twilight Dream) beats him.
lens_notes.utility_tool: Void Prison is a heroic choice with many uses (time stop for both teams), none of the catalog tool values fits cleanly.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Only the Void Prison heroic and Singularity Spike slow. The standard Basic Attacks build takes Might Of The Nerazim and has no hard CC.
lens_notes.cc_delivery: Void Prison is a wide area. Singularity Spike (soft slow) is a skillshot.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Blink, Vorpal Blade and Seeker in the Dark teleport out, but Wormhole blocks blinking back for 1.25 seconds.
lens_notes.camp_play: Icy Veins: Cleave is excellent at camps, but measured 2.9 camps per game is below average.
lens_notes.power_curve: Icy Veins: weak early game and very dependent on level 7 and 16 talents. Profile spike is late.
lens_notes.snowball: Icy Veins says he does badly on snowball maps (Tomb, Braxis), and he needs level 16 talents, not leads.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Standard Basic Attacks build takes Might Of The Nerazim (single target burst). Void Prison is a teamfight swing or defensive heroic in the other builds.
lens_notes.team_needs: No hard need, but Icy Veins wants sustained AoE damage heroes (Sylvanas, Gul'dan) since his damage is burst, and early game allies for his weak early game.
lens_notes.team_gives: Void Prison sets up combos with Diablo, Jaina, Nova. Cleave clears waves and camps.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Targeted CC like polymorphs and reveal abilities (Eye of Kilrogg), then killed quickly because of limited health.

lens_gaps: ultimate_role is single valued but Zeratul has two very different heroics (Might Of The Nerazim pick tool, Void Prison fight swing and setup).
No value for time stop or global CC on cc_profile (Void Prison affects allies too, and can protect structures and allies).
vulnerable_to has no value for 'revealed by reveal abilities or area damage' (stealth hero counter).
